result.title: Monitor-Validity Failures: LLM Safety Evidence Paths at Evolving Framework Boundaries
result.summary: Modern LLM applications rely on runtime monitors that inspect tool calls, traces, streams, detector outputs, and verifier inputs. This creates an interface-reliability problem: a framework path may remain operational while policy-relevant evidence never reaches its decision point. In one representative case, a regex detector returned a positive match, but the framework stranded the result before the block decision. This differs from jailbreaks and detector errors because the evidence is already recognized yet disconnected from enforcement. We study this repair-boundary signature with canary contracts: parent/fixed confirmation units that place a known payload only on the changed evidence surface and record monitor visibility together with the downstream decision for action-boundary cases. Applying the protocol to public framework repairs, we confirm 18 evidence-path failures across 11 LLM or agent safety project groups and four implementation ecosystems. Nine are established-boundary repairs, eight are new-surface policy-coverage gaps, and one is a boundary-only evidence case. Fourteen reach E1 enforcement boundaries: seven native action outcomes, six configured enforcement boundaries, and one synthetic-consumer consequence. The remaining cases affect verifier, safety-prompt, or observability channels. The cases form carrier, adapter, authority, and surface families and show how ordinary application behavior can remain intact while a safety-specific evidence path misses its decision. Exact revisions, deterministic outcomes, negative controls, and a frozen prospective audit document the confirmation rule. Monitor assumptions therefore need regression tests at the schemas, streams, tools, and adapters that frameworks evolve.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究 LLM 应用运行时监控的「证据路径失效」：即使检测器已识别出策略相关证据，框架也可能在到达阻断决策前将其丢弃，作者用 canary contract（父/固定确认单元）在多个开源框架修复中复现了 18 例此类失效并归纳出若干族类。
AI.relevance_reason: 其 canary contract 与负控制、确定性复现协议，可供核查 LVR 中「视觉证据已被编码却未进入答案决策」的旁路与信息坍缩现象，属方法借鉴线索；但论文本身面向 LLM 安全监控接口，迁移到多模态推理需人工判断可行性。
